ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity dark pixels across the visible ventral surface area with high-intensity white highlights localized at distal tips and water boundaries; ratio approximately 1:20.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped central notch with an acute angle at the vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration pattern; right lobe shows multiple sharp, upward-pointing peaks; left lobe features deeper, more irregular jagged indentations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the trailing edge sweeping upward and outward from the medial notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, high-intensity white pixel clusters with irregular, textured geometry localized at the extreme lateral tips of both fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Substantial irregular jaggedness and potential tissue loss along the mid-to-outer trailing edge of the left lobe, showing a more fragmented profile than the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced accumulation of high-relief, high-contrast white matter (biological encrustation) on the distal lobe tips.
